item.title: Trump says Democratic midterm wins would set country back a decade
item.description: President Trump framed the November midterms as a fight for America's future, warning that Democratic control of Congress would set the nation back.

item.title: Trump pledges $5,000 payout if Republicans win Congress in November
item.description: President Trump promised a $5,000 dividend to every adult U.S. citizen if Republicans win the House and Senate in the November midterms.

item.title: Silence on Campus Is Not the Answer
item.description: A year after Charlie Kirk's assassination, the case for speaking up on controversial topics remains.

item.title: How September 11 Permanently Reshaped American Politics
item.description: As memories of the attacks faded, counterterrorism measures drew greater scrutiny and voter priorities shifted.
